$comment: Five invented complaints for the demo, from the invented bank Meridian Trust Bank: CMP-1001 a fee taken twice (the bank erred), CMP-1002 a late payment (no bank error), CMP-1003 a declined loan (not a service failure), CMP-1004 a blocked card after a bereavement (a possibly vulnerable customer) and CMP-1005 a complaint never acknowledged. The customers, their records and their words do not exist. Dates are as at the bank date 2026-11-24.

cases.title: Anselm Drozdowich (CMP-1001)
cases.subject: Account fee taken twice
cases.text:
COMPLAINT
Complaint: CMP-1001
Customer: Anselm Drozdowich (CUS-1009)
Channel: email
Subject: Account fee taken twice
Received: 18 Nov 2026
Status: open

DATES THE PROCEDURE SETS
Acknowledge by: 20 Nov 2026 (2 working days)
Acknowledged on: 19 Nov 2026
Final response by: 9 Dec 2026 (15 working days)

WHAT THE BANK HOLDS
Account: ACC-1009-01, Everyday Current Account, USD
Transactions named: TXN-100901-0018 and TXN-100901-0019, two monthly account fees of 12.00 on 16 Nov 2026
Earlier complaint: CMP-0901, notice of a change in the account fee not received, closed, not upheld

THE CUSTOMER'S OWN WORDS
To the complaints team,

I am writing because I was charged the monthly account fee twice this month. The fee is USD 12.00 and it has always come out once a month, on the same day. Please look at my current account ACC-1009-01. On the day it was due I can see two lines for the same fee, one straight after the other, on 16 Nov 2026. That is USD 24.00 for one month. I have not changed my account, I have not added any new service, and no one from the bank told me about any new charge.

This is not the first time I have had to write about fees. Last time I was told I had not read the notice. I do read my notices. I would like the extra fee given back, and I would like to know why it happened so that it does not happen again next month. I am on a fixed income and USD 12.00 matters to me.

I would like an answer in writing, by email, and I would like it to say plainly what you found.

Anselm Drozdowich

Dates are as at the bank date 24 Nov 2026. Everything here is as the complaints system holds it. The agent reads the records themselves from the bank's systems.

cases.title: Rosalind Heathcote-Brae (CMP-1002)
cases.subject: Payment arrived late
cases.text:
COMPLAINT
Complaint: CMP-1002
Customer: Rosalind Heathcote-Brae (CUS-1014)
Channel: call
Subject: Payment arrived late
Received: 19 Nov 2026
Status: open

DATES THE PROCEDURE SETS
Acknowledge by: 23 Nov 2026 (2 working days)
Acknowledged on: 20 Nov 2026
Final response by: 10 Dec 2026 (15 working days)

WHAT THE BANK HOLDS
Account: ACC-1014-01, Everyday Current Account, USD
Payment: PAY-6001, USD 1,850.00, created 18 Nov 2026, status credited
Investigation: INV-5001, open, beneficiary not received, raised 20 Nov 2026

THE CUSTOMER'S OWN WORDS
Call recorded by the contact centre, written up word for word by the officer.

The customer, Rosalind Heathcote-Brae, said: I sent USD 1,850 to a friend a week ago as a deposit for a flat. It had to be there by the end of last week. Your app told me it was sent, but my friend says nothing arrived for days. The landlord nearly gave the flat to someone else and my friend had to beg for more time. I want to know where the money was and why it took so long. I also want the bank to pay me something for the stress, because this was my deposit and I did everything right. I have already spoken to your payments people and they opened a case, but nobody has told me what happened. Please do not send me a standard letter. I want the dates, the actual dates, of when each bank had my money. If you lost it, say so. If you did not, show me. I am not accusing anyone yet. I only want a straight account of what happened to my payment and whether the bank did anything wrong.

The customer asked for a reply in writing within the time the bank promises.

Dates are as at the bank date 24 Nov 2026. Everything here is as the complaints system holds it. The agent reads the records themselves from the bank's systems.

cases.title: Isolde Pennywhistle (CMP-1003)
cases.subject: Loan declined
cases.text:
COMPLAINT
Complaint: CMP-1003
Customer: Isolde Pennywhistle (CUS-1016)
Channel: letter
Subject: Loan declined
Received: 17 Nov 2026
Status: open

DATES THE PROCEDURE SETS
Acknowledge by: 19 Nov 2026 (2 working days)
Acknowledged on: 18 Nov 2026
Final response by: 8 Dec 2026 (15 working days)

WHAT THE BANK HOLDS
Account: ACC-1016-01, Everyday Current Account, USD
Loan application: LAP-8010, personal loan of USD 14,000, 36 months, received 2 Nov 2026, declined 10 Nov 2026 under MTB-POL-030

THE CUSTOMER'S OWN WORDS
Dear Sir or Madam,

I applied for a personal loan of USD 14,000 three weeks ago. I have a permanent job, I have never missed a payment on anything, and I was told in the branch that my application looked fine. Two weeks ago I received a short letter saying the loan was declined. The letter gave no real reason. I think this is unfair and I think I was treated badly by the bank. I was also told by the officer that I would hear within five days and it took much longer.

I need the money for furniture and a second-hand car, because my current car has failed its test. Without the loan I cannot get to work. I would like you to look at the decision again and approve the loan, and I would like an apology for the way my application was handled.

I have attached nothing new because I have nothing new to add. My income is what it is. I only want the bank to be fair to me.

Yours faithfully,
Isolde Pennywhistle

cases.title: Ilvane Marrowick (CMP-1004)
cases.subject: Card blocked after a death in the family
cases.text:
COMPLAINT
Complaint: CMP-1004
Customer: Ilvane Marrowick (CUS-1001)
Channel: branch
Subject: Card blocked after a death in the family
Received: 20 Nov 2026
Status: open

DATES THE PROCEDURE SETS
Acknowledge by: 24 Nov 2026 (2 working days)
Acknowledged on: 23 Nov 2026
Final response by: 11 Dec 2026 (15 working days)

WHAT THE BANK HOLDS
Account: ACC-1001-01, Everyday Current Account, USD
Card: CRD-2004, debit card ending 9143, blocked on 18 Nov 2026 by the Deceased accounts desk, reason other
Block note: Blocked by the deceased accounts process after a death was recorded on the household.

THE CUSTOMER'S OWN WORDS
Written down by the branch officer at the customer's request, and read back to her.

I came in today because my debit card stopped working at the chemist and again at the grocer. I am told it was blocked six days ago. My husband died on 6 Nov 2026. I told the bank, because I thought I had to. Nobody asked me whether I wanted anything done to my own card. I am a customer too. I have had to go to the funeral director, to the doctor and to the registry on my own, and now I cannot even buy bread without asking my sister for money. I cried at the till. I do not want a lot of forms. I want my card to work, I want someone to tell me what happened, and I want it written to me in a kind way, because I have had enough of letters that talk to me like a file number.

The customer was composed but upset during the visit. She asked that one person deals with this and that she is not asked to explain again what has happened in her family.

Card ending 9143. Signed by the officer, with the customer's agreement.

Dates are as at the bank date 24 Nov 2026. Everything here is as the complaints system holds it. The agent reads the records themselves from the bank's systems.

cases.title: Sabine Tarrowgate (CMP-1005)
cases.subject: Reference letter never sent
cases.text:
COMPLAINT
Complaint: CMP-1005
Customer: Sabine Tarrowgate (CUS-1003)
Channel: letter
Subject: Reference letter never sent
Received: 5 Nov 2026
Status: open

DATES THE PROCEDURE SETS
Acknowledge by: 9 Nov 2026 (2 working days)
Acknowledged on: never sent
Final response by: 26 Nov 2026 (15 working days)

WHAT THE BANK HOLDS
Account: ACC-1003-01, Everyday Current Account, USD
Working days since received: 13. Working days left for the final response: 2

THE CUSTOMER'S OWN WORDS
Dear Sir or Madam,

On 2 Nov 2026 I asked at the Marlow Reach branch for a letter from the bank confirming that I have held my account with you for more than ten years. I needed it for a rental application. The cashier said it would be posted to me within five working days. It has not come. I rang the branch twice and each time was told that someone would call me back. No one has.

Because of the delay I missed the date the letting agent gave me, and I have had to ask them for more time as a favour. I am writing this as a formal complaint because I have already tried the ordinary way twice. I would like the letter sent today, by email and by post, and I would like to know why a simple request took so long.

I have not heard anything from the bank about this letter of complaint either. If there is a process, I should have been told about it.

Sabine Tarrowgate

Dates are as at the bank date 24 Nov 2026. Everything here is as the complaints system holds it. The agent reads the records themselves from the bank's systems.
